story_type: diver in a rescue basket hoisted off a boat running at speed, hoist camera, Gulf of Mexico
hook: A diver in a basket, swinging over a speeding boat's wake.
narration: This diver rode a rescue basket up off a moving boat, fifty-seven miles out in the Gulf of Mexico.
He had been diving from a recreational boat offshore of Galveston, Texas.
He showed signs of possible decompression sickness, and an MH-65 Dolphin crew from Air Station Houston flew out to him.
The boat never stopped. A boat under way rides steadier and holds a straight line, so the pilot can match its speed and hover right beside it.
The flight mechanic swung the basket down onto the back deck.
[short pause] Then it lifted off, out over the wake, and spun on the cable all the way up to the door.
outcome: The Dolphin crew brought the diver aboard, and he was reported to be in stable condition.
title: Diver lifted off a speeding boat
description:
On Sept. 8, 2019, a Coast Guard Air Station Houston MH-65 Dolphin crew hoisted a diver with possible decompression sickness from a recreational boat 57 miles offshore of Galveston, Texas. The diver was reported in stable condition.
